slides.title: HAVING = [[group ka filter]]
slides.note: Club ka bouncer: **sirf 2+ logon ka group andar** 🕺

slides.title: Pehle [[groups]] bane
slides.note: Ab sirf woh dept chahiye jahan **1 se zyada** log hain

slides.title: HAVING [[laga do]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  COUNT(*) AS people
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

slides.title: WHERE vs [[HAVING]]
slides.note: Alias in HAVING (people > 1): MySQL chalata, **PostgreSQL nahi**

slides.title: Paisa wala [[filter]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  AVG(salary) AS avg_sal
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept
HAVING AVG(salary) > 60000;
slides.note: Sirf woh dept jinka **average 60k se upar** 🔥

slides.wrong:
SELECT dept, COUNT(*)
FROM employees
WHERE COUNT(*) > 1
GROUP BY dept;
slides.right:
SELECT dept, COUNT(*)
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
slides.why: WHERE ke time groups **bane hi nahi**, COUNT kiska? → **error**
